public.suggestedRevision: Add a small figure contrasting point-to-point connections with connection through a shared capability, showing the number of relationships to be maintained at, say, 10, 100 and 1000 participants. Include the maintenance implication the text already notes - that every update to one system puts every connection to it at risk - since recurring maintenance rather than initial build is where the cost actually falls.
